mapper.select: select pqi.id as queue_item_id, pqi.music_id as music_id, pqi.source_type as source_type, pqi.source_id as source_id, pqi.sort_no as sort_no, m.name, m.singer, m.duration, m.album, m.video_id, fim.size, fim.mime, fim.filename as link, fic.filename as cover from play_queue_item pqi inner join music m on pqi.music_id = m.id left join file_info fim on m.music_file_id = fim.id left join file_info fic on m.cover_file_id = fic.id where pqi.queue_id = #{queueId} order by pqi.sort_no, pqi.create_time
